KARAMJIT SINGH, J. (Oral)
Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail in case having FIR No.118 dated 23.7.2022 registered under Sections 406, 420 IPC at Police Station Mukerian, District Hoshiarpur.
On the last date of hearing detailed order was passed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court granting interim protection to the petitioner with further direction to join investigation.
Whether reasoned / speaking?

In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is hereby allowed and order dated 18.11.2022 is hereby made absolute.
